# 🗃️ Dataset Card Template

## Dataset name/version
Name, version and maintainer.

## Purpose and provenance
Origin, purpose and license.

## Schema
Features, types, units, target and missing-value rules.

## Collection/generation
Generator, seed, sampling and transformations.

## Population and limitations
What it represents, does not represent and known bias.

## Privacy and permitted use
Sensitive fields, authorization, retention and prohibited use.

## Quality and reproducibility
Completeness, duplicates, ranges, commit, environment and generation command.
